links.note: what Ravindra Sangeet refers to -> his own songs; 25123 is the concept that names the stream, 25124 Shanti Niketan is the institution
first Indian to win the Nobel -- 25122 verbatim
what the poet wants to do on days of happiness -> remember God; that is 'नत शिर होकर सुख के दिन में', concept 25130
what he does NOT want from God -> saantvana; 25127 is the refusal to have the Lord do anything for him, whereas 25128 is about not fearing vipada
besides prayer we also act ourselves -- 25126 has exactly that shape (elders bless, but you sit the exam yourself); 25125 the swimmer is the same idea without the prayer/blessing half
what he wants to carry -> his sorrows; stanza 'वहन कर सकूँ इसको निर्भय', i.e. do not lighten my load -- 25127, not 25129 which is about no helper being found
with whose help he wants to face calamity -> by himself; 25129 is 'कोई सहायक न मिले तो अपना बल पौरुष न हिले'
what he prays should not waver -> aatmik bal, the 'बल और पौरुष न हिले' of 25129 word for word
what he wants victory over -> sorrows; 'दुख को मैं कर सकूँ सदा जय' sits with 25128, the not-being-cowed-by-vipada prayer, not with 25127
the poet is an aastik -- the textual warrant is 25130's stanza, where even in good times he bows and recognises God's face and adds 'तुम पर करूँ नहीं कुछ संशय'
what he prays for -> strength to fight every calamity, explicitly not rescue from it; that distinction IS 25128
original language Bangla -- 25131 is the Bangla-to-Hindi translation concept; 25132 is Dwivedi's wider contribution
in days of happiness: humble, feeling God every moment -- 'क्षण-क्षण प्रभु का मुख पहचानें' of 25130
when surrounded by sorrow and cheated by people he will not doubt God; 'ठगे जाने' is vanchana, whose gloss is 25136
'निखिल मही द्वारा वंचना' asked directly -- the marked answer is the whole earth deceiving him, i.e. 25136's gloss of vanchana
'नत शिर होकर सुख के दिन में' quoted verbatim; 25130 is that line
why he refuses consolation -> he wants to feel the sorrow himself; 25127 is the Lord-should-not-have-to-do-it concept
prays for strength to conquer sorrow rather than to have it reduced -- 25128, the same fearlessness prayer
'तो भी मन में ना मानूँ क्षय' with the marked answer 'कार्य हानि होने पर' -- same stanza as 'कोई सहायक न मिले', so 25129
gloss of 'अनामय' = स्वस्थ, which is 25135 exactly; 25134 is vipada
central note of the poem is self-respect and self-confidence -- 25127 is the self-reliance concept; 25128 is narrower (fearlessness in one adversity)
on calamity he wants not to be afraid, not to be spared it -- 25128's description states this contrast
